# Synthetic multi-service experiment

**All data in this experiment are synthetic** (generated by `logfusion.synthetic`). Seeds: 1–10 (10 runs); seed 0 was used during development and is not included. Values are mean ± standard deviation over seeds.

## Window-level detection (test windows)

| Sources | Precision | Recall | F1 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| traces | 0.929 ± 0.093 | 0.480 ± 0.171 | 0.605 ± 0.150 |
| logs | 0.927 ± 0.055 | 0.302 ± 0.092 | 0.446 ± 0.105 |
| metrics | 0.923 ± 0.049 | 0.581 ± 0.058 | 0.711 ± 0.046 |
| traces+logs | 0.892 ± 0.104 | 0.492 ± 0.162 | 0.608 ± 0.131 |
| traces+metrics | 0.901 ± 0.073 | 0.860 ± 0.081 | 0.875 ± 0.043 |
| logs+metrics | 0.921 ± 0.034 | 0.857 ± 0.087 | 0.885 ± 0.050 |
| traces+logs+metrics | 0.881 ± 0.077 | 0.872 ± 0.076 | 0.871 ± 0.041 |

## Root-cause ranking (fused scores)

96 of 100 injected faults were detected in at least one window; rankings are computed for those. 10 services are ranked (random top-1 = 0.10).

| Method | Top-1 | Top-3 | MRR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Own anomaly score | 0.958 | 0.979 | 0.973 |
| Anomaly-guided walk on call graph | 0.958 | 0.979 | 0.972 |

| Fault type | Faults | Detected | Top-1 (score) | Top-1 (walk) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| cpu | 30 | 30 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| memory | 30 | 30 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| latency | 20 | 20 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| error | 20 | 16 | 0.750 | 0.750 |
